about.title: About Nest by Ammakkili
about.p1: Nest by Ammakkili is an online nightwear label founded on a simple philosophy: sleepwear should feel as gentle as a lullaby and withstand the warmth of everyday tropical living.
about.p2: We specialize in women's nighties tailored from hand-inspected pure cotton, breathable prints, and soothing satins.
about.p3: Every single design is showcased in high-definition video on our YouTube channel, letting you inspect the neckline, seams, texture, and fall before making a decision.

contact.title: WhatsApp Support
contact.lead: We respond exclusively via WhatsApp messages. We do not accept voice calls.
contact.ytNote: You can also watch our channel on {link}.

policies.title: Shop policies
policies.paymentText: All orders must be prepaid online via our secure payment gateway. Cash on Delivery (COD) is strictly not supported.
policies.returnsText: Because nightwear is personal intimate clothing, and each piece is quality inspected prior to dispatch, we do not accept any returns, replacements, or size exchanges once an order is confirmed.
policies.shippingText: We ship orders across India with trusted courier partners at a flat shipping fee of ₹60 per order. Orders are typically packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days.
policies.privacyText: We collect customer names, phone numbers, and delivery addresses strictly to process, dispatch, and communicate regarding orders.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Clear answers to help you order with complete confidence.
faq.q1: Can I return or exchange a nighty?
faq.a1: No. To maintain hygiene and quality, we operate a strict no-return and no-exchange policy. Please consult our bust measurement guide prior to ordering.
faq.a2: No. All orders are strictly prepaid via UPI, debit/credit cards, or netbanking.
faq.a3: No. We handle customer support exclusively via WhatsApp messages. We do not operate a telephone call center.
faq.q4: How do I choose the correct size?
faq.a4: Measure around the fullest part of your bust in inches with a measuring tape. Match it to our Size Guide table or use the interactive Bust Calculator.
faq.q5: How do I know my order is confirmed?
faq.a5: Once payment succeeds, you will see the confirmation screen with an order ID. You can click 'Send order details on WhatsApp' to connect with us directly.
